_comment: WI-tusad shrink-only ratchet over packages/hypergumbo-core/tests/test_stable_id_floor_gate.py's per-language fixture corpus (run with include_docs, so doc/config kinds count). floor_and_null: per language and kind (EVERY kind with a language), how many records ride the ADR-0035 backstop floor (id == make_declaration_stable_id(kind, language, path, name); a table kind has no floor key, so only its nulls count) and how many are null. sibling_deletion_moves: the languages where deleting an earlier same-name sibling moved, nulled or dropped another symbol's stable_id (any kind). The gate fails on any count above this baseline (or a language it does not list) AND on any count below it: when a producer migrates to the ADR-0035 formula, ratchet the entry down in the same change (the failure message prints the live values). Never raise an entry for an unchanged fixture; widening what the gate measures (WI-tusad B8a: every kind, 34 more fixtures) lists what the wider measurement finds. Target: both sections empty.
